Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Seiya Suzuki?

Seiya Suzuki is 31 years old.

When was Seiya Suzuki born?

Seiya Suzuki was born on August 18, 1994.

Where was Seiya Suzuki born?

Seiya Suzuki was born in Arakawa, Japan.

How tall is Seiya Suzuki?

Seiya Suzuki is 5-11 (180 cm) tall.

How much does Seiya Suzuki weigh?

Seiya Suzuki weighs 182 lbs (82 kg).

How many seasons has Seiya Suzuki played?

Seiya Suzuki is in his 5th season.

What position does Seiya Suzuki play?

Seiya Suzuki is a Rightfielder and Designated Hitter.

How many hits does Seiya Suzuki have?

Seiya Suzuki has 84 hits this season and has 620 hits over his career.

How many home runs does Seiya Suzuki have?

Seiya Suzuki has 15 home runs this season and has 102 home runs over his career.

What is Seiya Suzuki's average?

Seiya Suzuki has a .272 average this season and has a .269 average over his career.

How much is Seiya Suzuki worth?

Seiya Suzuki makes $19,000,000.00 this year. His current contract terms are 5 yrs/$85M (22-26).

How many teams has Seiya Suzuki played for?

Seiya Suzuki has played for 1 team, the Chicago Cubs.
